name: Cut Trees
desc:
🪓 Welcome to Cut Trees!

🪵 Cut wood to increase your power!
🎁 Open chests for new and powerful tools!
⚔️ Fight with your friends!

How to Play: Cut trees, collect chests, finish your run, open chests, and equip your new tools!
